gloss: auscultation; listening to internal body sounds

definitions.gloss: auscultation; examination by listening to internal body sounds
definitions.explanation: A medical examination in which a doctor listens to sounds from the heart, lungs, or intestines, usually through a stethoscope ({聴診器|ちょうしんき}). {聴診|ちょうしん}する means to perform this examination.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{胸|むね}→胸：00972_mune⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{聴診|ちょうしん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The doctor listens to the patient's chest.

examples.japanese: ⟦{聴診器|ちょうしんき}→聴診器：16293_choushinki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{当|あ}てて→当てる：01864_ateru⟧⟦{心音|しんおん}→心音：29097_shinon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{聴診|ちょうしん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The doctor placed a stethoscope on me and listened to my heartbeat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{肺|はい}→肺：12334_hai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{異常|いじょう}→異常：01716_ijou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧、⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{聴診|ちょうしん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had my lungs carefully examined to check for any abnormalities.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{聴診器|ちょうしんき}→聴診器：16293_choushinki⟧: stethoscope
- ⟦{心音|しんおん}→心音：29097_shinon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{聴診|ちょうしん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to listen to the heartbeat
- ⟦{肺|はい}→肺：12334_hai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{聴診|ちょうしん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to listen to the lungs

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{打診|だしん}→打診：05831_dashin⟧: percussion — tapping the body and judging the sound, a different examination method
- ⟦{触診|しょくしん}→触診：29098_shokushin⟧: palpation — examining by pressing and feeling with the hands
